model: OpenAir Zone Controller Actuator DXR1.E10PL - HvacFnct31 (Supply air VAV with reheat options)
applies_to: Single-duct VAV boxes with optional hot water or electric reheat, run by the Siemens DXR1.E10PL BACnet IP zone controller actuator (HvacFnct31 object set).
summary: The DXR1.E10PL is a damper actuator with a built-in BACnet IP room controller and airflow sensor for VAV, VVT and fan-powered boxes. This entry is the HvacFnct31 object set: supply damper position, heating valve or 1-3 stage / modulating electric reheat outputs, supply air temperature and box differential pressure, KNX PL-Link room unit status, room operating mode, comfort and economy setpoints, an air quality setpoint, and the supply airflow setpoint, measured flow and min/max limits.
notes: Object names here are the short names; on site each object name is prefixed with the building structure path (the doc shows wildcards such as %RSegm%'VavSuPos).

Many outputs and inputs exist in several alternative instances, one per hardware option (valve type, number of electric heat stages, channel used, room unit model). Only the instances matching the configured option are present on a given device.

Access: 'C' marks objects the list shows as writeable; others are read-only. The doc says room operating mode and the room setpoint are normally commanded at priority 15, and a value held at priority 5 means equipment protection is active.
A proprietary network-port object (type 264) in the device section is left out.
The temperature control section lists PrSpC twice (AV 36 and AV 45), one per cooling control variant (room temperature control or cascade control).
The doc lists two product types (DXR1.E10PL-112/US and -113/US) and two object sets (HvacFnct31 and HvacFnct33) but does not say which product or box type uses which set.

source.title: Zone Controller Actuator Variable Air Volume, Variable Volume Temperature, and Fan-Powered Box BACnet Objects

integration.summary: Command the room operating mode (MV 9) and the room setpoint (AV 54) at priority 15, then read room temperature, the heating/cooling state, supply airflow and the damper and heating positions.
integration.enable: The doc says the room operating mode is normally controlled from the BMS and must be written at priority 15; scheduled or manual central commands also use priority 15.
integration.remote_sensors: With a KNX PL-Link room unit the room setpoint can be adjusted through AV 54; with a DXR1.M09PxZ plus QMX1.M34H combination AV 54 may only be monitored, not written.
setup: The device name, instance and description are set by the user when the device is engineered; the doc gives no default instance.
The device IP address is shown in a proprietary network-port object in hex format.
gotchas: A value held at priority 5 means the equipment is in protection mode; check before overriding at a higher priority.
Which output instance is live depends on the configured reheat type and channel.
